scope: English-to-Chinese soil-science and adjacent natural-science translation. These rules diagnose source-language interference before the Chinese domain-register release audit.
literal_exception_policy: A forbidden Chinese rendering may remain only as an exact source-locked occurrence in an immutable quotation, official title, or procurement clause. A technical-sense label is not an exception.

resolution_by_sense.diagnostic_question: Which measured variable changes which actuator or control input?
preferred_target_realizations: 根据测量结果调节执行部件

resolution_by_sense.diagnostic_question: What problem is identified, what correction is taken, and how is effectiveness verified?
preferred_target_realizations: 发现问题、采取纠正措施并验证措施有效性
记录偏差处置和复核结果

resolution_by_sense.diagnostic_question: Does the source mean traceable records or correspondence among research questions, methods, results, and conclusions?
preferred_target_realizations: 目的、方法、结果和结论完整对应

rules.release_rule: The translator must recover the proposition from the source; the literal target is an error in translator-authored Chinese.

resolution_by_sense.diagnostic_question: Which sampling, custody, preparation, analysis, review, and archiving stages are actually included?
preferred_target_realizations: 从采样、运输、制备、检测到归档的各阶段

resolution_by_sense.diagnostic_question: Which source, input, transport, transformation, exposure, or fate processes are meant?
preferred_target_realizations: 列明投入、迁移、转化和归趋
说明各过程及其衔接关系

resolution_by_sense.diagnostic_question: Which production, storage, transport, processing, use, or recovery stages are within scope?
preferred_target_realizations: 分别列明生产、储存、运输、使用和回收阶段
按实际研究范围写明起止阶段

rules.release_rule: The translator must enumerate the stages or processes supported by the source; a total-scope label may not replace them.
